title: URL shortener with click counts
prompt:
Build a URL shortener in Python (standard library only, sqlite3 for storage) as a package shortener/ with shortener/__init__.py, shortener/codes.py and shortener/service.py.
- shortener/codes.py: ALPHABET = "0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ"; encode(n) turns a non-negative int into base 62 with that alphabet (encode(0) == "0", encode(61) == "Z", encode(62) == "10"); decode(s) is the reverse; a negative number or a character outside the alphabet raises ValueError.
- shortener/service.py: class Shortener(db_path=":memory:"). shorten(url, alias=None) -> the code. A url must start with http:// or https:// and have something after it, otherwise ValueError. Without an alias the code is encode(row id + 10000); shortening the same url again (without an alias) returns the same code. An alias must be 3 to 30 characters of letters, digits, _ or -, otherwise ValueError; an alias already in use raises ValueError too. resolve(code) -> the url (and counts one click) or None if unknown. stats(code) -> {"url": ..., "clicks": n} or None. top(n=3) -> a list of (code, clicks) with the most clicks first (ties by code).
Write unit tests too.
